meta.name: debug
meta.description: Debug container agent issues. Use when things aren't working, container fails, authentication problems, or to understand how the container system works. Covers logs, session DBs, mounts, and common issues.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 排查容器和 agent 运行问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常遇到容器或 agent 运行异常需要定位根因
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to diagnose container or agent runtime problems

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以诊断容器化代理系统的问题。它会检查日志、会话数据库和挂载点，帮助找出容器失败、认证错误或消息丢失的原因。
howto.when: 当容器代理不工作、容器启动失败、出现认证问题，或你想了解容器系统如何运作时触发。

say.text: 帮我检查容器代理为什么没有回复。
say.note: Claude 会查看日志和会话数据库，定位问题。

say.text: 看看有没有重复的 NanoClaw 服务实例在运行。
say.note: Claude 会检查进程列表，避免消息被错误标记为已送达。

say.text: 重启 agent 组 my-group 的所有容器。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can diagnose issues with the containerized agent system. It checks logs, session databases, and mount points to help find causes of container failures, authentication errors, or lost messages.
howto.when_en: Triggered when container agents are not working, containers fail to start, authentication problems occur, or you want to understand how the container system works.

say_en.text: Check why the container agent is not replying.
say_en.note: Claude will examine logs and session databases to locate the issue.

say_en.text: Check for duplicate NanoClaw service instances.
Restart all containers for agent group my-group.
say_en.note: Claude will execute the ncl groups restart command.
